meta.title: AgentBridge — PR Collaboration Workflow
meta.subtitle: End-to-End Mobile Review, Discussion, CI Verification & Guarded Merge
meta.description: Step-by-step workflow for mobile engineers inspecting PRs, reviewing changed files, checking review states, monitoring CI pipelines, viewing logs, and executing guarded merges.

states.label: PR Created / Selected
states.description: Operator selects a Pull Request from the paginated PR listing or opens it via /pr <num>.

states.label: Inspect PR Overview
states.description: Examines title, state, branch topology, author, commit count, and lines changed.

states.label: Review Changed Files
states.description: Inspects bounded list of modified files, additions/deletions, and modification badges.

states.label: Review State & Comments
states.description: Checks approvals or changes requested and views or posts discussion comments.

states.label: CI / Actions Checks
states.description: Monitors workflow run statuses; inspects tail-truncated build logs if failures occur.

states.label: Collaboration Decision
states.description: Determines whether to request revisions, rerun flaky tests, or proceed with PR merge.

states.label: Post Feedback / Revise
states.description: Posts review comments to PR thread prompting developer or agent adjustments.

states.label: Rerun CI Workflow
states.description: Triggers workflow run rerun under explicit human authorization.

states.label: Merge Preflight Check
states.description: Verifies live PR state, branch conflicts, and mergeability status against GitHub API.

states.label: Human Merge Authorization
states.description: Explicit human authorization required for HIGH risk PR merge. Auto-merge is strictly forbidden.

states.label: Execute Guarded Merge
states.description: GitHub REST merge endpoint called with verified method (merge, squash, rebase).
